extraction_notes: AP3404S is an n-channel enhancement MOSFET in a SOT23-3 package. The datasheet gives VDS = 30 V maximum and continuous ID = 6.5 A at TA = 25 degC, p. 1.
Threshold voltage is 1.2 V minimum, 1.6 V typical, and 2.5 V maximum at VDS = VGS and ID = 250 microA, p. 2.

RDS(on) is 20 mOhm typical and 24 mOhm maximum at VGS = 10 V, ID = 6.5 A; 39 mOhm maximum at VGS = 10 V, ID = 6.5 A and TJ = 125 degC; and 27 mOhm typical and 34 mOhm maximum at VGS = 4.5 V, ID = 5 A. The strict schema stores the typical resistance values and preserves maxima in this note.

Ciss = 345 pF typical and 690 pF maximum, Coss = 55 pF typical, and Crss = 32 pF typical at VDS = 15 V, VGS = 0 V, f = 1 MHz, p. 2. Capacitance scalars are stored in F; the p. 3 capacitance plot is retained as digitized traces.
Drain-source breakdown voltage is 30 V minimum at VGS = 0 V and ID = 250 microA, p. 2.
Body-diode forward voltage is 0.77 V typical and 1 V maximum at VGS = 0 V and IS = 1 A, p. 2. The strict schema stores the typical value.

Turn-on delay is 2.8 ns typical, rise time 7.2 ns typical, turn-off delay 15.8 ns typical, and fall time 4.6 ns typical at VGS = 10 V, VDS = 15 V, RL = 2.7 ohm, RGEN = 6 ohm; these timing values have no dedicated fields in the strict schema.

All plotted curves are manual digitizations of visible traces on p. 3. Curve coordinates are retained only where the trace identity and axes were attributable. The SOA panel was not converted because it contains multiple time-dependent limiting curves and no single target trace.
All current, voltage, capacitance, and resistance coordinates are stored in SI units. The device polarity is n-channel and all scalar and curve values use positive n-channel magnitudes.
extraction.omission_reason: Maximum RDS(on) and Ciss values, switching timing values, and the multi-curve SOA limits are published but have no dedicated fields in the strict MOSFET schema; they are preserved in extraction notes. No single SOA trace was asserted.
